compute_precision_recall: compute precision and recall from detection scores, boolean labels, and ground truth count
compute_average_precision: compute average precision from precision and recall numpy arrays using VOCdevkit definition
compute_cor_loc: compute CorLoc scores per class from ground truth image counts and correctly detected counts
test_compute_precision_recall: test compute_precision_recall with sample detection scores and labels to verify precision recall output
review_compute_average_precision: review compute_average_precision to understand the VOCdevkit area under precision recall curve calculation
